_about: Public-domain John Fletcher of Madeley (1729-1785, vicar of Madeley, Shropshire; Wesley's ally) for the Word Hoard: the Works (New York, 4 vols; catalogued 1833, but these copies carry the undated imprints of Carlton and Porter and of Carlton and Lanahan), raw Internet Archive OCR.
